mapper.sql: select q.id, q.category_id, c.category_name, q.question_type, q.question_title, q.question_content, q.question_options, q.correct_answer, q.question_analysis, q.difficulty_level, q.score, q.tags, q.status, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark from exam_question q left join exam_question_category c on q.category_id = c.id
mapper.select: where q.category_id = #{categoryId} and q.status = '0' order by q.create_time desc
where q.question_type = #{questionType} and q.status = '0' order by q.create_time desc
where q.difficulty_level = #{difficultyLevel} and q.status = '0' order by q.create_time desc
where q.tags like concat('%', #{tags}, '%') and q.status = '0' order by q.create_time desc
select count(*) from exam_paper_question where question_id = #{questionId}
select count(*) from exam_question where status = '0'
select question_type as questionType, count(*) as count from exam_question where status = '0' group by question_type
